name: Item number mistaken for a creation date (Wikidata)

origin.campaign: September 2026 — PubMed substrate and other corpora (Voûte)

seen.corpus: Wikidata dump 2026-08-31 (121.5 M items), Almageste Wikidata edition, read 2026-09-06, qnum
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the night reports of 2026-09-06/09
seen.excerpt: 06-09-2026 : « qnum n'est qu'un ordre de création : un Q bas veut dire créé tôt dans Wikidata, pas concept ancien ; les imports de masse déplacent des millions de numéros en quelques semaines. Aucune date ne doit être calculée depuis qnum ».
seen.excerpt_en: 2026-09-06: "qnum is only a creation order: a low Q means created early in Wikidata, not an old concept; mass imports move millions of numbers in a few weeks. No date must ever be computed from qnum".

prevention.refusal_clause: qnum is never read as a date

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

history.event: proposed by the Voûte Claude in 'FORMES-PUBMED-pour-Fault-Atlas (09-09-2026)' part 2 (sha256 51a338add43cd071…), form 36 of 40; effect on a graph: Dating a concept by its item number gives false births by the million (ANACHRONISM). Prevalence: structural.
history.by: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the night reports of 2026-09-06/09

history.event: converted to a record; class, prevention and the novel/variant question left to the second reader

proposed_severity.reason: the item number taken for a creation date: every claim of precedence answers wrongly, and nothing shows it
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most WRONG_VALUE forms (G2), so it adds little

registry_scope.extent: the whole base: the Q number is a creation order, not a date
registry_scope.why_not_a_prevalence: a fault of a registry has no prevalence: it is a property of the base, so everything drawn from that base carries it. What can be stated is the slice it touches.
registry_scope.source: read from this form's own observation, 2026-09-11
